title: Maria's New Job
text:
Maria is a nurse. She works at a small hospital in her city. She studied for four years at a university before she got her job. Every day, she helps patients and talks with doctors.

Maria likes her job very much. She wants to learn more, so she goes to an English class on Saturdays. Next year, she hopes to become a head nurse.

questions.text: How long did Maria study at the university?
Where does Maria go on Saturdays?
What can we infer about Maria?
options: She does not like her job
She wants to improve her skills
She wants to grow in her career
She does not have a job
She is a student at a school
She plans to become a teacher

vocabulary.definition: a place where sick people receive medical care
a place where people study after high school

paragraph_translations: Maria bir hemşiredir. Şehrindeki küçük bir hastanede çalışır. İşe başlamadan önce üniversitede dört yıl okudu. Her gün hastalara yardım eder ve doktorlarla konuşur.
Maria işinden çok memnun. Daha fazla şey öğrenmek istediği için cumartesileri bir İngilizce kursuna gider. Gelecek yıl baş hemşire olmayı umuyor.
